topic: Estimating data storage and cluster costs
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on providing a preliminary cost estimate for storing 60 million records, initially requested as a data lake solution. The participants debated whether to use a full data lake or ClickHouse (CH). It was determined that the required disk volume would be significantly smaller than initial estimates suggested. For calculation purposes, it was advised to base the storage on SSD capacity of 16-32 GB. Costing should include two servers plus volumes for approximately 40 GB, and must explicitly account for replication costs (which are noted as being nearly half the cost without them).
decisions: The preliminary estimate should be based on a calculation involving two servers and storage volumes of around 40 GB.
The cost estimate must include the expense associated with data replication.
action_items: Provide an estimated cost for the required infrastructure (two servers + 40GB volume) to [p1] for review.
